_source: Pat Morgan (House Help Utah / Simple Choice) Coaching Playbook: FUB drip + transaction tracker; Bearded Realtor listing course day 13; co-listing SLA template; Cory's post-close SmartPlan design. Nothing auto-sends: every step becomes a task with copy-ready text.

steps.title: Email 1: Welcome / intro
Call {{first_name}}: confirm welcome email, introduce yourself
Email 2: Local market snapshot
steps.body:
Subject: What is actually happening in the {{city}} market right now

Plain-English update: days on market, median price trend, one stat. Two paragraphs max.
Want a custom report for your neighborhood? Reply and I will send it.

Cory Salisbury, REALTOR | Simple Choice Real Estate | Equal Housing Opportunity

steps.title: Text {{first_name}}: personal check-in, no pitch
Email 3: Why you / personal story
steps.body:
Subject: Why I got into real estate (the short version)

Four or five sentences: local roots, what you care about, the clients you love. Warm, not salesy.

Cory Salisbury, REALTOR | Simple Choice Real Estate | Equal Housing Opportunity

steps.title: Record a 30-second video text for {{first_name}}
Email 4: Home valuation or hand-picked listings
steps.body:
Subject: Curious what your home is worth? / A few homes you might like

Offer a free, no-obligation home valuation OR a few hand-picked listings that match what they told you. Include a link.

Cory Salisbury, REALTOR | Simple Choice Real Estate | Equal Housing Opportunity

steps.title: Call {{first_name}}: quick check-in, no agenda
Email 5: Client story
steps.body:
Subject: How we got the {{story_family}} family into their home

A short, real client story: challenge, what you did, outcome. End: Every situation is different. If yours feels complicated, that is when I would love to chat.

Cory Salisbury, REALTOR | Simple Choice Real Estate | Equal Housing Opportunity

steps.title: Text {{first_name}} a relevant listing or local stat
Email 6: Direct ask
steps.body:
Subject: {{first_name}}, where are you at?

It has been a month. Are you closer to buying or selling, on pause, or just exploring? Whatever the answer, I would love to know. {{phone}} or {{calendar_link}}.

Cory Salisbury, REALTOR | Simple Choice Real Estate | Equal Housing Opportunity
